Egypt

text: Ahlan, Kaylee! I'm Miu the kitten!
Ahlan means hello! Come explore Egypt with me!
Tap a spot on the map!
Everyone is here! Tap the light show!
Get all the stamps to start the light show!

Kaylee, you did it! You won the Egypt Explorer trophy!
Kaylee, Egypt Explorer! From Egypt.

text: Hee hee! My bandages are ticklish!
I'm Jamal the camel. Let's build a pyramid!

Drag the stone onto the glowing spot!
Three big stones on the bottom!
Now pick the smaller stone. Small stones go on top!

text: Oof! Too big for up there!

Two stones in the middle!
Now one little stone on the very top!
Last, the golden cap! It is a triangle!
Long ago, Egyptians built pyramids for their kings, the pharaohs!

text: Let's sneak inside the pyramid! It's dark in here!

Drag Miu through the tunnel to the scarab!
Now find two scarabs!
Find the way to the treasure room!

text: A scarab! Egyptians loved these beetles.
Shh! A sleepy bat! Not this way.

The treasure room! Tap the golden box!
This gold mask was made for a boy king called Tut!

text: I napped for thousands of years! Hee hee!
All aboard! Let's sail down the Nile River!

Drag the boat up and down to catch the lotus flowers!
The farm is thirsty! Pull the bucket down three times!
This farm is thirsty too! Pull the bucket five times!

text: Look! The water makes the plants grow!

Egypt is mostly sandy desert. The Nile makes it green!
The Nile is one of the longest rivers in the world!

text: Oh no! Someone is buried in the sand!

Rub the sand away!
Now brush the sand off his paws!
Two big lion paws!
Now brush off his back!
The Sphinx has a lion's body and a person's head!
You found pieces of an old pot! Put it back together!

text: Thank you, Kaylee! Hmm, have you seen my nose?
Hee hee! His nose fell off a long, long time ago!
Long ago, Egyptians wrote with little pictures called hieroglyphs!

Let's write your name, Kaylee, like a pharaoh!
Press and hold the stamp that matches!
K says kuh! Find the basket!
A says ay! Find the bird!
Y says yuh! Find the two reeds!
L says lll! Find the lion!
E says ee! Find the reed!
E again! One more reed!
Look for the same picture!
Kings and queens wrote their names in an oval like this!

text: Welcome to my market stall! Let's make koshari!

Follow the recipe! First, the rice!
Next, the lentils!
Now the pasta!
Now the tomato sauce!
Crispy onions on top!
Look at the recipe! What comes next?
Koshari is a yummy Egyptian food!
Add three pinches of onions!
Press and hold to pour! Let go at the gold line!

text: Whoops! A little too much! Hee hee.

Drag a light onto the pyramids!

text: Hee hee! I love the lights!
Ho ho! I shine at night!
Yum! Thank you for the koshari!

Pull the rope to raise Egypt's flag!
Egypt's flag is red, white and black, with a golden eagle!

text: Shukran, Kaylee! You're a true Egypt explorer!

Camel sticker! Camels store fat in their humps for long trips!
Scarab sticker! Egyptians thought scarabs were lucky!
Hippo sticker! Hippos love the cool Nile water!
Fennec fox sticker! Big ears help it stay cool in the desert!
Ibis sticker! Egyptians drew this bird in their picture writing!
Kitty sticker! In Egypt, cats were loved like family!
Egypt is hot and sunny, and it hardly ever rains!
In Egypt, people say Ahlan! It means hello!
Shukran means thank you in Arabic, the language of Egypt!
The pyramids are more than four thousand years old!
The Nile River gives Egypt water for farms and for drinking.
Long ago, Egyptians wrote with pictures called hieroglyphs!
In ancient Egypt, cats were loved like family!
Koshari is rice, lentils and pasta with yummy sauce!
This is Egypt! Tap a picture to learn more.

Let's see the real Nile River!
